tasks.title: Prepare five-year business plan and executive summary
tasks.involved: Compliance; Product; Risk; CTO; Brazilian Legal
tasks.why: BCB may require the business plan in whole or part, and the executive summary must describe the actual operating model, group relationships, relevant services, governance, IT, risks and economics.
actions: Build at least five-year market, operating and financial plan.
Describe Brazil strategy, target market, products, competitors and market-share assumptions.
Document group structure and Kinetic–Rules relationships.
Describe outsourced services, governance, IT, controls, AML framework and physical structure.
Create open-formula financial model supporting viability assumptions.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Counsel-reviewed business-plan package is internally consistent with the filed operating model and financial projections.

tasks.title: Administrator fit/proper, knowledge and technical-capacity dossier
tasks.regulatoryBasis: IN 704 Phase 2 administrator declarations and Res. 519 authorization criteria
tasks.why: Phase 2 requires evidence around management suitability and knowledge of the business, market, funding, risk and operations.
actions: Build dossier for each proposed administrator.
Collect declarations, authorizations, CV/background and supporting competence evidence.
Document collective management knowledge and allocation of responsibilities.
Resolve eligibility, availability or conflict concerns early.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Each administrator has a complete, signed and legally reviewed Phase 2 dossier.

tasks.title: Controller economic-capacity and source-of-funds dossier
tasks.why: BCB authorization review extends beyond whether capital arrived; controllers must be capable of supporting the institution and the source must be transparent.
actions: Identify documentary evidence required for each controller.
Prepare financial-capacity analysis and supporting financial information.
Collect source-of-funds/source-of-wealth declarations and evidence.
For foreign controllers, prepare applicable multi-year financial information.
Cross-check with CG-05 capital funding.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Controller dossier demonstrates documented financial capacity and transparent funding provenance.

tasks.title: Build Phase 2 governance, IT, risk and control evidence book
tasks.involved: Risk; CISO; CTO; AML; Finance; Operations
tasks.why: The regulator and auditor need a coherent evidence story showing that the described institution actually exists in operational form.
actions: Create index covering governance, organization, IT, outsourcing, AML, risk, controls, custody and reporting.
Link each policy to operating evidence and accountable owner.
Capture configuration extracts, committee records, test results and reconciliations.
Run a mock authorization review and remediate gaps.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Evidence book can support BCB review and independent assurance without last-minute document hunting.

tasks.title: Engage CVM-registered auditor for Annex IV reasonable-assurance report
tasks.involved: Procurement; Brazilian Legal; AML Director; Board
tasks.regulatoryBasis: IN 704 as amended by IN 739/2026, Annex IV
tasks.why: Phase 2 requires a reasonable-assurance report from a CVM-registered independent auditor covering AML-related control areas. Auditor lead time is the reason to start Phase 2 work now.
actions: Identify CVM-registered firms with relevant capacity/experience.
Issue scope based on current Annex IV.
Agree evidence period, testing approach, timetable and remediation window.
Execute engagement and create PBC tracker.
Schedule readiness assessment before formal fieldwork.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Qualified auditor is contracted with a timetable that leaves time to remediate findings before Phase 2 submission.
tasks.risk: External dependency with limited ability to compress timetable.

tasks.title: Obtain Annex IV reasonable-assurance report
tasks.involved: CVM-registered auditor; Board; All AML control owners
tasks.regulatoryBasis: IN 704 art. 10 X / Annex IV as amended by IN 739
tasks.why: The final report is a Phase 2 filing deliverable, not merely an internal audit comfort letter.
actions: Complete auditor PBC requests and walkthroughs.
Remediate readiness findings before final testing.
Support design and operating-effectiveness testing.
Escalate potential qualified/adverse issues immediately.
Obtain final signed report and archive remediation evidence.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Final CVM-auditor report is available for the Phase 2 submission with no unresolved critical findings.

tasks.title: Assemble Phase 2 submission pack and decision-trigger playbook
tasks.why: The Phase 2 clock is triggered by BCB's Phase 1 decision. The aim is to be substantially ready before that clock starts.
actions: Create Phase 2 master checklist and document index.
Pre-populate forms that do not depend on the BCB Phase 1 decision.
Define day-0 process when the favorable notice arrives.
Maintain statutory countdown with an earlier internal filing target.
Run final submission simulation including signatures and system access.
tasks.definitionOfDone: The team can move from favorable Phase 1 notice to complete Phase 2 filing without building substantive documents from scratch.
